name: Arisu Ruri
source:
An actress who made a name of herself by being a "service idol" in the past - an idol that did neither dance nor sing. She is proficient in cooking and often stars in cooking shows. Because of her motherly nature she is called "Mamatare (ママタレ)".
Ruri met her husband through the entertainment business and wants to have children with him, but cannot due to him often traveling outseas. Due to her occupation, she doesn't feel guilty about cheating on him.
